profile.grammar_notes: Two copulas: ser (identity, origin, traits) and estar (location, current state); hay for existence. Pro-drop: subject pronouns optional, verb endings carry person. Politeness marked grammatically: tú vs usted (ustedes for plural 'you' in Latin America, no vosotros). Negation with no before the verb, double negatives required (no...nada/nadie/nunca). Questions by intonation plus question words (qué, dónde, cuándo, cómo, por qué, quién, cuánto). Modals/must: poder, querer, tener que, deber, hay que. Near future: ir a + infinitive. Past: pretérito vs imperfecto (aspect). Object pronouns (lo/la/le/me/te) and reflexive se; gustar-type verbs with indirect object. Closed sets: subject pronouns, object pronouns, question words, articles, demonstratives, possessives, weekdays.
